parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles from molecule_dictionary joined to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures on molregno. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
